The Celestial Bridge. An arched bridge at the base of the floating city, supporting large transparent spheres reflecting celestial maps, with a serene blue body of water visible in the distance.

STYLE LOCK — NON-NEGOTIABLE:

Identity:
* large spherical objects
* map reflections

Materials:
* arched bridge
* transparent blue spheres
* cracked moon-like sphere
* plain sphere

Color & Light:
* pale cream spheres
* reflection of a world map

Atmosphere:
* contemplative
* vistas

Banned:
* modern technology
* gritty realism

SCENE LAYERS:
- Background: Distant serene blue body of water, framed by fluffy white clouds under a clear midday sky. Horizon line visible.
- Midground: The Celestial Bridge, an arched structure of pale cream material, supporting large transparent blue spheres. The spheres display reflections of a world map and some appear cracked and moon-like.
- Foreground: The base of the arched bridge, visible from a street-level perspective, with hints of cobblestone or similar ground texture. The tilt of the camera emphasizes the upward view of the bridge and spheres.

LIGHTING: Bright midday sun, casting soft shadows. The transparent spheres refract and reflect the sky and celestial map. Pale cream light emanates from the map reflections within the spheres.
ATMOSPHERE: Contemplative mood, emphasizing grand vistas and a sense of wonder. Serene and ethereal.

[SPACE:] EXTERIOR - OUTSIDE view of the building/location
[ENVIRONMENT:] clear with fluffy white clouds, midday
[CAMERA:] camera positioned on approach path with elevated perspective, 25-30° downward tilt, ultra-wide view capturing entrance within broader environmental context, entrance visible but not dominating frame, extensive surroundings visible, layered depth from immediate foreground through distant background, balanced composition showing full architectural context
[LENS:] 12-24mm ultra-wide lens, elevated perspective, expansive framing
[LIGHT:] directional natural light with atmospheric haze, environmental motion (wind-blown mist, drifting clouds, shifting shadows), parallax depth through weather conditions

[NEG:] interior, indoor, inside room, indoor scene

[FILTER: NoLivingSubjects] DON'T INCLUDE: humans, people, faces, characters, animals, creatures, silhouettes, bodies, watermark, signature.
